scope: Explicit package add/remove matching only. Local remove changes configuration, not package files. No frame/delta/progress callback changes. Existing find/filter closures stay at the explicit command boundary.
costs: Canonical resolution adds required filesystem identity work. Input is once per command; each local settings candidate once. Existing SettingsManager structuredClone, snapshots, writeQueue and result array remain; no new cache/pool or general timing/zero-allocation claim.
compatibility: Input cwd and settings user agentDir/project .sp bases preserved; add preserves object filter fields. Missing paths use lexical identity. Case-sensitive objects remain separate; denied project trust and npm name/git host/path matching preserved.
coverage: Real Windows case and junction/case-sensitive fixtures; POSIX symlink counterpart in Node26 CI. Remote package matching is offline; no npm/git uninstall or publication.
